newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary forint firmer vs dlr, as dlr/mark drops.
newsitem.headline: Hungary forint firmer vs dlr, as dlr/mark drops.

text.p: The Hungarian forint closed stronger on Tuesday following a drop in dollar/mark, dealers said, adding that the forint narrowed its gap from the central bank's resistance level.
The forint ended at 182.18/23 to the dollar, compared with 182.54/59 at midday, and 182.60/70 at opening.
"In moderate trading the forint went back to the central bank's bid just before the end of the session but by the close it distanced itself again to five pips," said Peter Luczo of Inter-Europa Bank.
In morning trade the forint was 10 pips weaker than the central bank's bid.
The forint floats against a basket made up 30 percent by the dollar and 70 percent by the mark.
